text: わかったよ　あそんでって　やるぜ！

structure.jp: あそんでって　やるぜ！
structure.en: I'll play with you for a while!

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: あそんでって　やる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you do it as a favour for someone, said from above in a rough way. あそんでって　やる = 'I'll do you the favour of playing a while'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく after a verb says you do it and then go on your way. Here あそんでいって is shortened in speech to あそんでって. あそんでって = 'play for a bit before going'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, tough-guy talk that pushes what you say at the listener. やるぜ = 'I'll do it for you, all right!'.
